say:4:1460114002:1.text: What a spectacular showdown! Alsa's reshaping the battlefield like it's clay, and Soren's darting through it like lightning—keeping the enemy on their toes!
say:4:1460114002:1.source_cn: 阿尔萨巧妙地使用魔法圈定地形，索恩恰到好处地袭扰，尽可...

say:5:1460114003:1.text: And Brutus! That sword swing could level a mountain!
say:5:1460114003:1.source_cn: 与此同时，布鲁特斯大人狂野的剑势也能够发挥出最强的效果！

choice_prompt:6:1460114003.text: And Brutus! That sword swing could level a mountain!
choice_prompt:6:1460114003.source_cn: 与此同时，布鲁特斯大人狂野的剑势也能够发挥出最强的效果！

say:7:1460114004:0.text: When there's a fight and a little drama, there I am—Mikola, the world's most dazzling host!
say:7:1460114004:0.source_cn: 哪里有战斗，哪里有热闹，哪里就有我，最出色的主持人曼卡拉！
say:7:1460114004:0.male: When there's a fight and a little drama, there I am—Mikola, the world's most dazzling host!
say:7:1460114004:0.female: When there's a fight and a little drama, there I am—Mikola, the world's most dazzling host!

say:8:1460114006:1.text: With the sharp-eyed Satrana at my side, our rhythm is unbeatable!
say:8:1460114006:1.source_cn: 而且，有萨忒娜配合，解说时就更有节奏了！
say:8:1460114006:1.male: With the sharp-eyed Satrana at my side, our rhythm is unbeatable!
say:8:1460114006:1.female: With the sharp-eyed Satrana at my side, our rhythm is unbeatable!

say:9:1460114007:1.text: "Satrana, how would you rate Soren's last move?"
say:9:1460114007:1.source_cn: “萨忒娜小姐，刚刚索恩的这一击，你怎么看？”

say:10:1460114008:1.text: "Mikola, it was brilliant as always—but Alsa's support deserves just as much praise!"
say:10:1460114008:1.source_cn: “曼卡拉小姐，这是非常成功的袭击，但我认为阿尔萨的及时...

say:14:1460114010:1.text: Satrana, how did you end up... co-hosting with Mikola?
say:14:1460114010:1.source_cn: 萨忒娜，你怎么和曼卡拉成为……呃，主持人搭档了啊？

say:15:1460114011:1.text: I wanted to improve my divination skills, and Mikola convinced me.
say:15:1460114011:1.source_cn: 我其实是想锻炼自己的占卜技巧，不过曼卡拉说服了我。

say:16:1460114012:1.text: "Reading the flow of battle and calling it in real time—now that's seeing the future!" she said.
say:16:1460114012:1.source_cn: 在疾风骤雨的擂台上，能准确地捕捉未来的片刻并及时解说，...

say:17:1460114013:1.text: That sounds less like prophecy, more like reading the flow of battle...
say:17:1460114013:1.source_cn: 比起预言，这更像是捕捉战机的眼光吧……

say:19:1460114014:0.text: Anyway, Master Pang—what do you think of all this?
say:19:1460114014:0.source_cn: 啊，说到观战眼光，潘，你怎么看？

say:22:1460114015:0.text: Both ladies speak with precision and grace. They always seem to choose the exact moment their words are needed.
say:22:1460114015:0.source_cn: 两位小姐的解说精准又出色，每次都把握到了最好的时机。

say:23:1460114016:0.text: Each time a thought forms in my mind, I find they've already spoken it.
say:23:1460114016:0.source_cn: 我每次刚想说什么，就发现她们已经实时进行了评价，完全找...

say:24:1460114017:1.text: All I can say is... what a thrilling match. Even as a mere observer, I felt the fire of battle stir within me.
say:24:1460114017:1.source_cn: 我只能说，这是一场精彩绝伦的战斗，我即使只是在旁观战，...

say:27:1460114018:1.text: Also, we heard your conversation earlier!
say:27:1460114018:1.source_cn: 刚刚各位的讨论我们也听到了！我支持阿尔萨的想法！

say:28:1460114019:0.text: I, Mikola the magnificent, am all in on Alsa's tournament plan! I live for battle and excitement!
say:28:1460114019:0.source_cn: 因为我——世界第一的主持人曼卡拉，最喜欢的就是热闹和打架！

say:33:1460114021:0.text: But that brings us back to our earlier dilemma. How do we make this thing actually happen?
say:33:1460114021:0.source_cn: 但这样一来，问题就又要回到前头的讨论了——成本和筹备工...

say:34:1460114022:1.text: In terms of scale, if we host it only around the desert, it won't top the Warsong Festival.
say:34:1460114022:1.source_cn: 从规模上而言，如果只在沙漠周围组织，很难超越战歌节。

say:35:1460114023:1.text: But if we open the gates to everyone—wandering warriors, hungry challengers from all across the land—
say:35:1460114023:1.source_cn: 但如果把各地喜欢巡游的，好战的家伙们组织起来，大家一起比赛！

say:36:1460114024:0.text: Wouldn't that be a one-of-a-kind, unprecedented tournament?
say:36:1460114024:0.source_cn: 还能见识各地不同的武学，这不是前所未有的超级大赛吗！

say:40:1460114025:1.text: Yes! And we could charge entry fees for participants!
say:40:1460114025:1.source_cn: 对！而且，也可以从他们那里收报名费！

say:43:1460114026:1.text: And why not sell tickets to the audience too?
say:43:1460114026:1.source_cn: 那这样的话，是不是也可以收门票费？

say:44:1460114027:1.text: The price doesn't have to be high, but we can set different rates based on seating and time!
say:44:1460114027:1.source_cn: 价格不用很高，但不同位置和时间都可以设定不同价格！

say:45:1460114028:1.text: That way, contestants' friends and families could also come visit the Ashen Wastes!
say:45:1460114028:1.source_cn: 这样，参赛者们的亲朋好友还能顺便来荒角沙漠旅游！

say:46:1460114029:1.text: Exactly! The more people, the more hype—and the more hype, the more income! A perfect cycle!
say:46:1460114029:1.source_cn: 没错！人多热闹，越热闹就越有钱赚！这不是完美循环吗！

say:48:1460114030:1.text: Also, there's something I've always wanted to see...
say:48:1460114030:1.source_cn: 而且，其实曼卡拉我呀，一直很好奇！

say:49:1460114031:1.text: The famed knights of the <style="highlight">Lightbearer Empire</style>—they're said to be legends!

say:50:1460114032:1.text: But they almost never take on friendly duels... always tied up by honor, by duty...
say:50:1460114032:1.source_cn: 可是听说他们身负使命，基本不会接受无意义的战斗邀请……

choice_prompt:51:1460114032.text: But they almost never take on friendly duels... always tied up by honor, by duty...
choice_prompt:51:1460114032.source_cn: 可是听说他们身负使命，基本不会接受无意义的战斗邀请……

say:52:1460114033:1.text: And! What about the mages from the Serene Lyceum? So many mages lost in books, in theories... wouldn't a real tournament shake things up?
say:52:1460114033:1.source_cn: 而著名的莱希拉姆魔法学院的法师们呢，大部分都热爱研究，...

say:53:1460114034:0.text: That's why I need you—yes, you, oh great <style="stress"><player_name></style>—to help make this dream real!
say:53:1460114034:0.source_cn: 所以，所以呀，我好想趁机长长见识，伟大的<style=...

choice_prompt:54:1460114034.female: That's why I need you—yes, you, oh great <style="stress"><player_name></style>—to help make this dream real!

say:55:1460114035:0.text: Hehe, and it's not just me getting fired up. Master Pang here looks eager too, right?
say:55:1460114035:0.source_cn: 嘿嘿，不光是我，其实这位潘先生也想去看看的，对吧？

say:59:1460114036:1.text: Indeed. Truth be told, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have long admired the swordsmanship of the Lightbearer Empire.
say:59:1460114036:1.male: Indeed. Truth be told, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have long admired the swordsmanship of the Lightbearer Empire.
say:59:1460114036:1.female: Indeed. Truth be told, <style="stress"><player_name></style>, I have long admired the swordsmanship of the Lightbearer Empire.

say:60:1460114037:1.text: But as a guest in these lands, I feared I might give offense if I asked too boldly.
say:60:1460114037:1.source_cn: 只是我毕竟是个远来的旅人，在异国之地不好太过冒犯，所以...
say:60:1460114037:1.male: But as a guest in these lands, I feared I might give offense if I asked too boldly.
say:60:1460114037:1.female: But as a guest in these lands, I feared I might give offense if I asked too boldly.

say:63:1460114038:1.text: Don't worry! With the Magister's recommendation, you're golden!
say:63:1460114038:1.source_cn: 放心吧，有主人的引见，肯定没问题！
say:63:1460114038:1.male: Don't worry! With the Magister's recommendation, you're golden!
say:63:1460114038:1.female: Don't worry! With the Magister's recommendation, you're golden!

choice:54:1:2.text: Fine, so stop with the puppy eyes!
choice:54:1:2.male: Fine, so stop with the puppy eyes!
choice:54:1:2.female: Fine, so stop with the puppy eyes!

choice:51:0:1.text: So you do know how to hold back.
choice:51:0:1.source_cn: 你也知道战斗是无意义啊
choice:51:0:1.male: So you do know how to hold back.
choice:51:0:1.female: So you do know how to hold back.

say:65:1460114005:0.source_cn: 嗯哼！在最恰当的时机为观众们解说台词，是主持人的基本功哦！
